title: SSH root login disabled
remediation: Set 'PermitRootLogin no' in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and restart sshd.

title: SSH password authentication disabled
remediation: Set 'PasswordAuthentication no' in /etc/ssh/sshd_config to require key-based authentication.

title: Firewall service active
remediation: Enable and start a host firewall service (firewalld, ufw, or nftables/iptables).

title: Audit daemon (auditd) active
remediation: Install and enable auditd to satisfy NIST 800-171 3.3.1 audit logging requirements.

title: World-writable files not present in /etc
remediation: Remove world-writable permissions from files under /etc (find /etc -xdev -type f -perm -0002).

title: Automatic login disabled (no passwordless accounts)
remediation: Lock or set a password on any account with an empty password field in /etc/shadow.

title: Unattended/automatic security updates enabled
remediation: Install and enable an automatic patching mechanism to satisfy NIST 800-171 3.14.1 flaw remediation.
